excluded_sources.other_NASA_cells: Not included in this comparison; heterogeneous protocols/baselines are not quality-cleared by the reviewed cohorts.

calce_cs2_reconstruction_audit.reason: Preliminary raw-channel reconstruction showed implausible tail candidates; prior data audit flagged overlapping session exports.
calce_cs2_reconstruction_audit.interpretation: This is a quality-control diagnostic, not a scored CALCE result.

harmonization.SOH: 100 * capacity / first measured capacity of that cell
harmonization.next_record_target: next measured SOH change per 100 cycles; scaled by the scheduled next observation interval when reconstructing next SOH
excluded_shared_features: absolute capacity in Ah (cell capacities differ)
ambient temperature (field meaning differs across source formats/protocols)
absolute cycle count as a shared feature (cycle/time scales differ)

validation_design.independent_unit: complete held-out cell; no rows from the held-out cell are used in model fitting
validation_design.multi_dataset_weights: equal total weight per source family, equal weight per cell in family, equal weight per row in cell
validation_design.external_family: train on other families only; no same-family examples in training
validation_design.uncertainty: cell-level errors and observed ranges only; no inferential confidence intervals

RUL.endpoint: first observed capacity <= 70% of that cell's first observed capacity
RUL.limit: This comparative endpoint does not replace the deployed NASA model's absolute 1.4 Ah endpoint.

scope: Laboratory cells only; no EV pack or field validation is claimed.
